旅程和设备档案按世界隔离。继续旧旅程保留当前档案；导入完整备份会同时恢复该备份的: Progress is saved separately for each world. Importing a full backup also restores its player profile.
此处的故事已经告一段落，请查看章节目标。: This part of the story is complete. Check your goals.
穿戴装备、选择修炼，再前往下一个地点。: Check equipment and training before your next stop.
按商店实际回收价结算: At the shop's listed buying price
目前没有可出售的物品。: You have no items to sell.
离开商店后可穿戴新装备、调整修炼或保存进度。: Leave the shop to equip items, change training or save.
难度影响战斗规则与历练所得。: Difficulty affects combat rules and experience.
第一周目没有额外开局伙伴，伙伴需在旅途中结识。: Meet your companions on the road during your first journey.
门派介绍、师父与入门剧情来自原版。选择后会继续对应拜师剧情；选择“无门派”则独自: Choose a school to meet its teacher, or remain unaffiliated and make your own way.
选择秘籍不会消耗物品: Selecting a scroll does not consume it
同时主运一门: One equipped mastery at a time
尚未学会内功，先选择上方秘籍修炼。: Select an available scroll to begin learning a mastery.
行囊中尚无秘籍。: No training scrolls in your inventory.
选择一本秘籍修炼，战斗结束后获得修炼经验。主运流派单独选择，会影响实战效果。: Select a scroll to gain training XP after battle. Choose your equipped mastery separately.
在下方选择一本已有的研习手册，战斗结算后积累经验。: Select an owned scroll below to gain training XP after combat.
无额外属性或身份门槛。: No additional attribute or identity requirements.
战斗中的消耗与范围会随天赋、装备和状态变化，以出招面板为准。: Costs and range can change with talents, equipment and effects. Check the combat panel.
随身兵刃、衣甲与饰物。点击行囊中的装备即可穿戴，属性会同步更新。: Equip weapons, armor and accessories from your inventory. Attributes update immediately.
行囊中暂无可穿戴装备。可以在商店购入装备，研习手册请到修炼页选择。: No available equipment. Visit a shop for gear; select scrolls on the Training page.
此栏为空，得到装备后可在这里穿戴。: This slot is empty. Equip an item here once you have one.
基础面板属性没有变化，请结合装备说明和附加效果选择。: Base attributes are unchanged. Check the item's other effects before deciding.
战斗中的条件触发、招式专属加成不全部体现在面板属性中。: Conditional combat effects and technique bonuses are not all shown in base attributes.
人物状态已变化，请重新打开装备对比。: The character has changed. Open the comparison again.
人物或物品状态已变化，请重新对比。: The character or item changed. Compare again.
已选择修炼秘籍，战斗结算后获得修炼经验。: Scroll selected. Study XP is awarded after combat.
已暂停这部秘籍的修炼，已学武功和经验保留。: Training paused. Learned skills and experience are retained.
战斗中可查看人物与行囊、使用可用丹药；换装与调整修炼请先返回地图。: Inspect characters and inventory, or use available consumables. Return to the map to change gear or training.
当前可查看人物与行囊。请结束剧情交互或离开商店后再调整。: You can inspect characters and inventory. Finish this interaction before changing them.
当前只可查看，请结束当前交互后再调整。: Inspection only. Finish the current interaction before making changes.
此人物由剧情安排离队，当前只可查看；后续能否归队由剧情决定。: This companion has left for story reasons. Their return depends on the story.
此人物当前为剧情随行，只可查看；参战与培养需等待后续剧情安排。: This person is accompanying you for story reasons. Combat and training become available later.
此人物正在后备休整；可在队伍编排中归队参战，再进行培养。: This companion is in reserve. Return them to the active party before training.
当前可查看名册；请返回地图并结束交互后调整队伍。: Return to the map and finish the current interaction before changing your party.
可换装、修炼与调整顺序；每场实际出场人数仍由遭遇决定。主角固定在首位。: Change equipment, training and order here. Encounter rules set the deployed party size. The hero remains first.
由你安排休整，保留装备与成长；回到地图后可随时归队，培养需先归队。: Reserve companions keep their equipment and progress. Return them to the active party to train.
随剧情同行，当前可查看人物；能否参战由后续剧情决定。: This companion's combat availability depends on the story.
归队由剧情决定，不能通过队伍编排直接召回。已有人物资料仍可查看。: This companion returns through the story. Their records remain available.
仅实际参战人物在结算时获得本场秘籍经验；后备保留修炼选择。主运功法与秘籍修炼分别: Only deployed characters gain scroll XP after combat. Reserve characters keep their selections. Equipped mastery and scroll training are separate.
同伴会实际加入队伍，并在允许组队的战斗中出场。手动模式可操作当前行动的每名队员。: Companions join the party and deploy where encounter rules allow. In manual mode, control each active ally.
入门体验目标已完成，教学任务仍在进行。请按上方任务继续；两者分别记录。: Chapter goals are complete, but a training task is still active. Follow the task above.
入门体验目标已完成，可以继续结识伙伴、修炼武学与探索江湖。: Chapter goals complete. Continue meeting companions, training and exploring.
本章目标已全部达成，可保存此次旅程。: All listed chapter goals are complete. You can save your journey.
回顾此次旅程，或继续探索与培养伙伴。: Review your journey, or keep exploring and developing your party.
当前已列目标完成，不代表整个世界的剧情全部结束。: These goals are complete; other stories may remain.
消息随成长出现；与相关人物交谈，可继续经历后续故事。: New leads appear as you grow. Talk to the people involved to continue their stories.
当前旅程暂无记录。: No records in this journey yet.
包含操作反馈和错误；这部分仅保留在本次页面中。: Includes actions and errors from this browser session.
获得物品、升级、对白和操作历史: Items, levels, dialogue and recent actions
调整战斗方式与阅读习惯，修改后自动保存到当前浏览器。打开面板时战斗暂停，关闭后继: Adjust combat and reading settings. Changes are saved in this browser. Combat pauses while a panel is open.
手动选格与出招，或由电脑代你行动；战斗中可随时切换。: Control movement and attacks, or let the computer act. Switch modes during combat.
影响行动间隔与演出速度，不改变战斗规则和伤害。: Changes action and animation speed without changing combat rules or damage.
回到地图、装备或修炼调整后保存自动进度；手动存档单独保留。: Autosaves on the map and after gear or training changes. Manual saves are kept separately.
自动进度和手动存档按世界分别保留，标题页可读取最近进度或手动存档。对话、商店和战: Autosaves and manual saves are separate for each world. Finish dialogue, trade or combat before saving. Export a full backup from Inventory.
隐藏格线后，仍会显示可移动与可出招的位置。: Movement and attack highlights remain visible without grid lines.
在角色上方显示实际伤害、治疗与内力变化。: Show damage, healing and energy changes above characters.
环境明暗、当前行动聚光与受击、治疗柔光；关闭可简化画面。: Ambient lighting, active-unit focus and hit or healing effects.
缩短移动演出，关闭动态柔光与受击动画，保留静态环境光。: Shorter movement and fewer animated effects, with static lighting retained.
放大剧情、物品说明、战况和操作文字。: Enlarge dialogue, item descriptions, battle reports and controls.
场景与战斗音乐；调到0关闭。: Scene and battle music. Set to zero to mute.
出招、用药和升级音效；调到0关闭。: Attacks, items and level-up sounds. Set to zero to mute.
保存当前地图进度: Save progress at the current location
保存未能完成，请导出存档备份后重试。: Save failed. Export a backup before trying again.
行动已完成，但自动保存未能写入。请保存或导出备份。: Action completed, but autosave failed. Save manually or export a backup.
无法导入此存档，请使用本版导出的存档文件。: Cannot import this file. Use a save exported by this version.
存档未能读取，请检查存档文件。: Could not read the save file.
设置已在本次游玩生效，但此浏览器暂不能保存设置。: Settings applied for this session, but this browser could not save them.
每次交易数量请填写 1 至 99 的整数。: Enter a whole quantity from 1 to 99.
未找到静态地图入口；演出或其他触发方式尚待核对，不能视为可直接招募。: No confirmed map entrance. Other triggers still need verification.
每一场交手，都是下一程的起点。: Every battle prepares you for the road ahead.
片刻凝神。点击继续，恢复交手。: Take a breath. Continue when ready.
自动交手中，可随时切换手动接管。: Automatic combat. Switch to manual control at any time.
先走位，再择招。落子之前，自有分寸。: Move first, then choose a technique.
凝神观察，等待行动时机。: Observe and wait for your turn.
选择招式，查看战场中标出的可用目标。: Choose a technique to highlight valid targets.
点击青色格移动；选一门武学，即可切换出招。: Select a cyan tile to move, or choose a technique to attack.
点击橙色目标格施展所选武学；也可直接点击对手。: Select an orange target tile or an enemy to use your technique.
收拾心绪，待调息后再来讨教。: Recover and prepare for another attempt.
确认后移动。取消可重新选择位置。: Confirm to move, or cancel to choose another tile.
选招后返回战场，点目标格确认施展。: Choose a technique, then select a target on the field.
当前可查看招式；手动操控且轮到我方时可选招。: Inspect techniques now. Select one on an ally's manual turn.
查看战场高亮范围选择目标。: Choose a target from the highlighted tiles.
世界暂未展开: The world could not be loaded
加载未能完成，请刷新后重试。: Loading failed. Refresh and try again.
请点击高亮格移动，或选择武功后点击橙色目标格出招。: Select a highlighted tile to move, or choose a technique and an orange target tile to attack.
手动战斗时，青色格表示可移动的位置。选择招式，点击橙色目标格施展；有些招式可对自: Cyan tiles show movement. Choose a technique and an orange tile to attack. Some abilities can target yourself. Switch to automatic combat, change speed or pause at any time.
打开人物、设置等面板时战斗暂停。离开战斗、对话和商店后可保存进度。不同应用及内容: Combat pauses while panels are open. Save after leaving combat, dialogue or shops. Export a backup from Inventory before clearing browser data.
各内容包分别保存进度。地图上的当前进度会在切换前保存；对话、商店和战斗中无法保存: Worlds have separate saves. Finish dialogue, trade or combat before switching.
消耗品只能在战斗中使用。: Consumables can only be used in combat.
开始闯荡金庸世界。: Your journey among the stories begins.
该物品已无法带来新的效果: This item can no longer add any effect.
战斗胜利，已按原有规则结算经验和掉落。: Victory. Experience and drops have been awarded.
战斗超出原版时限，判为失败。: The battle time limit expired: defeat.
战斗结束。可返回地图重新切磋。: Battle ended. Return to the map to prepare and try again.
已停止秘籍修炼；已学武功保留。: Scroll study stopped. Learned techniques are retained.
